name: @red-cup-engineering/software-mission-customer-induction-service
description: Deterministic actuator that validates proposal delta evidence and forms a JS-Mark induction manifest.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one verified proposal-only software mission result and its explicit customer writable lane
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: unverified output, customer mutation authority, malformed delta evidence, or a path outside the writable lane

form-js-mark-induction-manifest.accepts: one verified software mission proposal and customer mission authority declaration
form-js-mark-induction-manifest.returns: one deterministic proposal-only JS-Mark induction manifest or refusal
